title: Shopper
slide_intent: Connect a human delivery encounter to the identification item someone can inspect at close range.
strategic_value: Showing a person with groceries beside the branded lanyard can make the shopper role and its identifier easier to associate.
demonstration: An outdoor portrait of a person holding groceries fills one half. A close crop on the other half shows a dark green card with the carrot and a repeated wordmark on its strap.
practical_value: Use the portrait to establish the role and the detail photograph to specify how the identifier appears on a lanyard.

content_islands.name: Shopper portrait
content_islands.spec: Fill the left half with the person and paper grocery bags in context.

content_islands.name: Lanyard detail
content_islands.spec: Fill the right half with a close-up on a warm ground. Keep the swivel, strap lettering and graphic on the hanging card visible.
